name: happy_path
why: One 200 with a well-formed body. Pins the request URL, which must contain the literal 'api_key=None' -- see api_key_omitted_breaks.

name: conditional_request_sends_if_none_match
why: A non-None etag is sent as If-None-Match (ridewithgps.py:91-92).

name: etag_empty_string_not_sent
why: The guard is `if etag:`, so an empty string sends NO header -- an empty cached etag silently becomes an unconditional request.

name: not_modified_304
why: 304 returns (etag, None) and stops (ridewithgps.py:104-106). This is the whole point of the cache: no download and no pdflatex run.

name: not_found_404
why: Any non-304 HTTPError becomes RideWithGpsError('Unknown Route ID'), which the web layer turns into the 'not a valid route' page. Note a 500 from RideWithGPS is reported to the rider as a bad route id.

name: server_error_500_reported_as_bad_route
why: Same handler as 404 -- the message blames the route id regardless.

name: one_timeout_then_success
why: socket.timeout is swallowed and the loop retries (ridewithgps.py:110).

name: two_timeouts_then_success
why: Second retry still succeeds; Max_Attempts is 3.

name: three_timeouts_exhausts_retries
why: All three attempts time out -> RideWithGpsError('No data ... after 3 tries') (ridewithgps.py:113-114).

name: malformed_json
why: json.loads failure -> RideWithGpsError with the raw body inlined into the message (ridewithgps.py:116-119).

name: empty_body
why: An empty 200 body is falsy, so it takes the 'No data' path rather than the JSON-decode path (ridewithgps.py:113).

name: api_key_omitted_breaks_parsing
why: THE TRAP. Without api_key in the query string RideWithGPS returns a FLAT object -- name/course_points/distance at top level, no 'route' wrapper and no 'metrics'. The parser reads data['route'] at ridewithgps.py:122 and raises KeyError. A rewrite that 'cleans up' the stray api_key=None silently switches response shapes and breaks. Recorded as an executable warning.

name: missing_metrics
why: Wrapped but without 'metrics' -> KeyError from ridewithgps.py:158.

name: explicit_api_key
why: Passing a real api_key changes the URL. Nothing in the repo ever does this, but the parameter exists.
